Package bakerydms

Class MySqlOrderRepository

  • java.lang.Object
    • bakerydms.MySqlOrderRepository
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    OrderRepository
    public class MySqlOrderRepository
extends java.lang.Object
implements OrderRepository
    Stores orders in the orders table of a MySQL database (the data layer).

    This is the OrderRepository the real program uses. Each method runs one SQL statement:

    • Create - INSERT INTO orders ...
    • Read - SELECT ... FROM orders
    • Update - UPDATE orders SET ... WHERE order_id = ?
    • Delete - DELETE FROM orders WHERE order_id = ?
    • Report - SELECT ... WHERE pickup_date = ? AND is_picked_up = FALSE
    Every query is a PreparedStatement with ? placeholders, so text typed by the user can never change the SQL (no SQL injection). Changes are saved as soon as each statement runs, so they can be seen right away in MySQL Workbench or the MySQL command line.

    Objects of this class are created by DatabaseConnector and used only through OrderManager. The table and column names are fixed because the bakery_dms.sql script creates them. Every SQLException is turned into a DataAccessException with a plain-English message.

    Version:
    4.0 (Phase 4, Module 11)
    Author:
    Kayla Ewing
